definitions.explanation: The process of restoring electrical energy to a battery.
Figuratively, resting and recovering one's energy.

examples.japanese: ⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{充電|じゅうでん}する。
{充電|じゅうでん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{完了|かんりょう}→完了：02560_kanryou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{充電|じゅうでん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れそうだ→切れる：01936_kireru⟧。
examples.english: The battery is about to die.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{充電|じゅうでん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦おく→おく：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: I charge my phone before going to bed.

⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{充電|じゅうでん}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。

examples.english: After working for half a year, I plan to take a month off and recharge.

notes:
COMPOUND: {充|じゅう} (fill) + {電|でん} (electricity)

USAGE:
・{充電|じゅうでん}する takes the device or battery as its object with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧: ⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{充電|じゅうでん}する.
・The noun also names the stored charge itself, not just the act of charging. That is why it appears with ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ in {充電|じゅうでん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れる→切れる：01936_kireru⟧ ("the battery dies") and {充電|じゅうでん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧ ("the charge is low"). Learners who read {充電|じゅうでん} only as "charging" find these puzzling.
・{充電|じゅうでん}⟦{中|ちゅう}→中：09840_chuu⟧ labels the ongoing state, as on a device screen.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{充電|じゅうでん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to charge)
・{充電|じゅうでん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れる→切れる：01936_kireru⟧ (charging runs out)
・{充電|じゅうでん}⟦{中|ちゅう}→中：09840_chuu⟧ (charging)
・⟦{充電|じゅうでん}{器|き}→充電器：05106_juudenki⟧ (charger)
・⟦ワイヤレス→ワイヤレス：08509_waiyaresu⟧{充電|じゅうでん} (wireless charging)
・⟦{急速|きゅうそく}→急速：02634_kyuusoku⟧{充電|じゅうでん} (fast charging)

FIGURATIVE USE:
・Sense 2 applies the battery image to a person. Here there is no ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ object — you simply {充電|じゅうでん}する, and the implied thing being charged is yourself.
・{充電|じゅうでん}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧ (recharging period) — time off to rest and recover. Often used of a performer or athlete on hiatus, where it is a softer way of saying they have stopped working.
・The figurative sense is casual and positive; it is not used of recovering from illness, which takes ⟦{回復|かいふく}→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧ instead.

ANTONYM:
・⟦{放電|ほうでん}→放電：19289_houden⟧ (discharge)
